title: Apache Airflow is reachable without signing in
summary: The Airflow API answers unauthenticated, which exposes the pipelines and can run or change them.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("metadatabase") and body_contains("scheduler") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Require authentication on the Airflow web server.
